pages.text: Companions take care of themselves with what is in their $(thing)backpack$():$(li)Out of combat and hurt, they eat $(item)food$() until healed.$(li)They drink $(item)Healing$() and $(item)Regeneration$() potions; the empty bottle is discarded.$(li)In an emergency they prefer the strongest items, like $(item)golden apples$().

pages.title: Retreat
pages.text: When their health gets low and they carry something to heal with, they $(thing)roll away$(), retreat and eat before returning to the fight.$(br2)Without any food they keep fighting. They do not regenerate on their own: carry food and potions for them. (Servers can turn natural regeneration on in the config.)
